task: Experimental confirmation of Floquet-Bloch states in monolayer epitaxial graphene via tr-ARPES
key_commitments: Energy- and momentum-resolved observation of Floquet-Bloch replica bands
Quantification of replica band separation matching pump photon energy (0.248 eV)
Polarization dependence analysis to distinguish Floquet-Bloch from LAPE
Volkov final state scattering mechanism identification
Comparison with theoretical predictions from Floquet theory
comparison_axes: Replica band positions vs Floquet theory predictions
Polarization dependence: cos²(2θ) for Volkov vs isotropic for true Floquet
primary_references: Wang et al. (2013) - Floquet-Bloch states on TI surface
Sentef et al. (2015) - Floquet band formation theory in graphene
Oka & Aoki (2009) - Photovoltaic Hall effect in graphene
